title: Person v2
description: A historical or fantasy figure referenced in the Writer's Research Companion knowledge base

birth_year.description: Birth year in ISO 8601 or approximate format (e.g., '1845', '~1800')

death_year.description: Death year in ISO 8601 or approximate format

related_entries.description: Array of TimelineEntry IDs this person appears in

entry_type.description: Whether this person is historical or fantasy. Defaults to 'historical' if omitted.

universe_id.description: Fantasy universe/campaign this person belongs to. Only for fantasy persons.

personality.description: Personality traits and behavioral patterns (for AI narrator use). Fantasy persons only.

motivation.description: Core motivation or driving goal (for AI narrator use). Fantasy persons only.

speech_style.description: How this character speaks (for AI narrator dialogue generation). Fantasy persons only.
